product_metadata.title: 11.8 Inch Stainless Steel Frying Pan with Lid, Frying Pan with Steel Handle, Nonstick Pan with 6 Pcs Silicone Utensils, Dishwasher and Oven Safe
features: 【 POFESSIONAL ETCHING TECHNOLOGY】Our non sticking frying pan is using high precision etching process, forming a large honeycomb dual surface, which greatly improves nonstick performance. The frying pan is covered with a complete honeycomb protective layer, so you can cook with less oil without worrying about burnt food.

【TRI-PLY CONSTRUCTION DESIGN】Tri-ply construction to ensures long life and durability of the frying pan. Both inner and outer layers are sturdy 304 stainless steel for sturdy non-stick features, middle layer aluminum conducts heat quickly and evenly, safe and healthy cooking. Oven safe to 500°F. For induction, ceramic, gas and electric Stove

【ALL-IN-ONE FRYING PAN 】You will not only get a frying pan, glass lid and steel handle, but also get 6 pcs silicone utensils, like slotted turner, solid spoon, round spatula, basting brush, kitchen tongs, solid turner. These food grade safe silicone utensils, heat-resistant, not-melting, PFOA-free, which is friendly to your non-stick cookware. Used together with a frying pan to make your cooking more convenient and simple.
【SCRATCH RESISTANT】With this nonstick frying pan, you can don't worry about scuff or wear down from the use of metal utensils, also it is easy to clean and dishwashers safe.

【WARRANTY & SERVICE】Each frying pan is carefully selected to ensure that it is safe and durable. We also provide each customer with lifetime after-sales guarantee services. You can use the frying pan to stir fry, fry eggs, fry steak, chicken steak, etc. Welcoming to the next generation of cookware.
description: We have been developing a state-of-the-art cooking solution for every professional chef or cooking enthusiast, so this frying pan was born. The frying pan is suitable to use on all cooking stovetops, support a variety of cooking methods, and also equipped with 6 pcs silicone utensils to make your cooking more convenient and easy.
1 x 11.8 inch Non Sticking Frying Pan
The nonstick pan made of premium stainless steel, no chemical coating, no contain PFOA/C8/PFOS chemicals matter and using a professional etching to get excellent non-stick properties.

The frying pan come with sturdy stainless steel long handle, comfortable and heat-insulated, get a better cooking experience. NOTE: The frying pan handle needs to be installed manually, please check the instruction manual for installation.

The frying pan lid made of heat-resistant visualized tempered glass, which can easy to watch cooking progress, it can prevent the oil or the water from splashing on hand, which can give you a more comfortable cooking environment.

1. Before use, please wash with warm water and dry, then need to preheat with oil for 2 to 5 minutes to the oil at the bottom will flow and spread around, can start cooking.(Stainless steel frying pan is a nonstick wok, no seasoning required.)
2. Our frying pan with the merit of fast heat conduction, try to keep it on medium heat cooking, it can provide the original food.
